title: Vertical ties reinforcing.
officialText: Vertical tie reinforcing shall not be less than the equivalent of one No. 4 bar, at a maximum spacing of 48 inches (1219 mm) on center. A minimum of four continuous No.4 bars shall be provided per masonry column or pier.
